items.title: Joe Harris Interview, 1961-04-12
items.q: That's the thing I was trying to think of, Harry.

ctx.x: I've been selling the French market. The Black Cat, but by the old French market. That's what that job was playing.
I went with Smiling Joe. That's the thing I was trying to think of, Harry. What's the name of that club was by the French market? You had the Black Cat. Kingfish. Yeah, the Kingfish.
